tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_queenofpain_shadow_: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.
The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_queenofpain_bio: The Ecclesiast-King of Elze nursed a desire for pain--forbidden pain. In a less prominent political figure, such desires might be considered unwise, but in a monarch of his stature, to satisfy such thirsts would have threatened the virtue of the Divine Throne itself. Therefore he turned to his dungeon full of demonologists, promising freedom to whoever could summon a personal succubus of torment and bind it entirely to his service. The creature who arrived, Akasha by name, visited upon him such exquisite torments that he named her his Secret Queen, and he began to spend all his spare moments submitting to her clever torments--eventually abdicating all his responsibilities in his pursuit of the painful pleasures that only she could bring. Queen of Pain could bring him to the brink of death, but she was rune-bound to keep him alive. At last the King's neglect of state brought on an uprising. He was dragged from his chamber and hurled from the Tower of Invocations, and at the moment of death, Queen of Pain was let loose into the world, freed from servitude--freed to visit her sufferings on anyone she deigned to notice.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_queenofpain_hype: Queen of Pain strikes without warning, destroying gathered foes with deafening screams. Should an enemy survive her onslaught, she slows their escape with a throw of her dagger before finishing them off.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_queenofpain_npedesc1: Blinks in to deal massive magical damage

fields.value: The closer the enemy units, the stronger the Akasha's spell lifesteal for herself will be.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Spell lifesteal is less effective on creeps.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: For Akasha, spell lifesteal also works with Pure damage sourced to Akasha.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|bonus ls-spl}}
** Stacks additively with other [[spell lifesteal]] sources.
*** {{Symbol|a|Down}} 
**** The spell lifesteal value reduces by {{calc|(v4-v3)/(v1-v2)*100 round2|v1={{#var:Succubus value1}}|v2={{#var:Succubus value2}}|v3={{#var:Succubus value3}}|v4={{#var:Succubus value4}}|%}} per 100-distance between Akasha and the affected enemy unit up to the min bonus radius.
** Does not spell lifesteal on the following sources and units:
*** Self-damage sources.
*** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
*** Sources with the {{M|no-spell-lifesteal}} flag.
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The offensive {{M|spell damage}} applied on Akasha.
*# The {{M|spell lifesteal}}.

**** The spell lifesteal value reduces by {{calc|(v4-v3)/(v1-v2)*100 round2|v1={{#var:Succubus value1}}|v2={{#var:Succubus value2}}|v3={{#var:Succubus value3}}|v4={{#var:Succubus value4}}|%}} per 100-distance between Akasha and the affected enemy unit up to the min bonus radius.
** Does not spell lifesteal on the following sources and units:
*** Self-damage sources.
*** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
*** Sources with the {{M|no-spell-lifesteal}} flag.
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The offensive {{M|spell damage}} applied on Akasha.
*# The {{M|spell lifesteal}}.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, applies all ability effects on the debuff-affected enemy unit.
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}  {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
*** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+{{#var:Shadow Strike type4 value1 agh}}|v1={{#var:Shadow Strike cast range}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
*** {{cf|aghnotes}}
**** The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} changes the ability targeting functionality from {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted to {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted. 
**** Releases {{M|projectiles}} toward all valid enemy units within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Shadow Strike type4 value1 agh}}|agh}} radius centered around the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location upon cast. 
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units. However, they instantly {{M|disjoint}} the projectile.
***** {{M|Untargetable}} units.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*#* Applies the first {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} upon [[projectile]] impact.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|queenofpain_shadow_strike}}
*#* Reapplying the debuff {{M|dispels}} the current debuff, then reapplies the debuff while resetting the damage instance interval.
*#* {{Symbol|Deny}}
*#** The deny component considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*#* The debuff has three main components:
*#** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*#*** The 1<sup>st</sup> damage interval is applied {{#var:Shadow Strike type1 value1}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Shadow Strike type1 value1 tal}}|15tal}}) seconds after casting, subsequent damage instances are applied within the same intervals, over {{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:Shadow Strike inst|trunc({{#var:Shadow Strike value3}}/{{#var:Shadow Strike type1 value1}})}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:Shadow Strike inst tal|trunc({{#var:Shadow Strike value3}}/({{#var:Shadow Strike type1 value1}}-{{Show|T|Queen of Pain|v2r}}))}}}}|15tal}}) damage instances.
*#**** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{M|talent|t=t2r}} value affects the instance interval and is defined as:
*#***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Intervals {{=}} [[Wikipedia:Floor and ceiling functions|⌊]] [[Debuff]]Duration / ({{#var:Shadow Strike type1 value1}} - {{ValueColor||{{Show|T|Queen of Pain|v2r}}|tal|x}}) [[Wikipedia:Floor and ceiling functions|⌋]]}}
*#** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|a|Down}} {{Symbol|Movement Speed}} 
*#*** The [[movement speed]] slow ({{Code|S}}) applied diminishes in 1-second intervals non-linearly from the max applied value, and the n<sup>th</sup> {{Code|S}} instance is defined as:
*#**** {{cf|expr}}
*#***** {{Code|S<sub>n</sub> {{=}} {{#var:Shadow Strike value2}} × 0.815 ^ (n-1) × 0.985 ^ ( ((n-1)(n-2)) / 2 )}}
*#***** {{Code|n {{=}} 1}} is the 1<sup>st</sup> instance.
*#** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus t2l}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Attack Speed}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#*** {{cf|talnotes}}
*#**** Grants flat [[attack speed]] bonus upon Akasha's {{M|attack point}}, as long as Akasha is attacking the debuff-affected unit(s), regarding of the Shadow Strike's source.
*#**** This ability component does not consider {{M|illusions}} as valid units.
*#**** Learning the {{ValueColor||bonus attack speed|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1r}} immediately grants Akasha the ability bonuses.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Releases {{A|Queen of Pain|Scream of Pain}} {{M|projectiles}} of its corresponding level within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Shadow Strike type5 value1 agh}}|agh}} radius, centered around the debuff-affected enemy unit upon losing {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|queenofpain_shadow_strike}} in any way.
** Other Scream of Pain notes apply.
** Has the following properties upon proc:
*** Works independently of Scream of Pain's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
*** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
** Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} immediately updates the current debuff instance.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_queenofpain
data.bio_loc: The Ecclesiast-King of Elze nursed a desire for pain--forbidden pain. In a less prominent political figure, such desires might be considered unwise, but in a monarch of his stature, to satisfy such thirsts would have threatened the virtue of the Divine Throne itself. Therefore he turned to his dungeon full of demonologists, promising freedom to whoever could summon a personal succubus of torment and bind it entirely to his service. The creature who arrived, Akasha by name, visited upon him such exquisite torments that he named her his Secret Queen, and he began to spend all his spare moments submitting to her clever torments--eventually abdicating all his responsibilities in his pursuit of the painful pleasures that only she could bring. Queen of Pain could bring him to the brink of death, but she was rune-bound to keep him alive. At last the King's neglect of state brought on an uprising. He was dragged from his chamber and hurled from the Tower of Invocations, and at the moment of death, Queen of Pain was let loose into the world, freed from servitude--freed to visit her sufferings on anyone she deigned to notice.
data.hype_loc: Queen of Pain strikes without warning, destroying gathered foes with deafening screams. Should an enemy survive her onslaught, she slows their escape with a throw of her dagger before finishing them off.
data.npe_desc_loc: Blinks in to deal massive magical damage

abilities.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.
notes_loc: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

abilities.name: queenofpain_blink
abilities.desc_loc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
abilities.lore_loc: The Secret Queen lives up to her title, making her pain impossible to escape.
notes_loc: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
abilities.shard_loc: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
abilities.desc_loc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

%damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
abilities.lore_loc: The sultry voice of Akasha beckons her opponents while stealing their souls.
notes_loc: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: queenofpain_succubus
abilities.desc_loc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
facets_loc: Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.

abilities.desc_loc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.

notes_loc: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.
